To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

immersive, high-fidelity, simulated clinical placements are effective for improving the confidence of novice physiotherapy students in the clinical setting, and that the students who have experienced immersive simulation placements achieve higher levels of clinical competence during their subsequent clinical practice placements.

(a) immersive simulation is a valuable learning experience for novice physiotherapy students; (b) students’ confidence in their clinical abilities improved during the immersive simulation placement; and (c) students’ clinical competence was higher in students who completed an immersive simulation experience compared to students who did not complete the immersive simulation experience.
immersive simulation can be an effective way to prepare physiotherapy students for their clinical placement.
